_comment: F5/F7 memory inventory for the Home-Automation-SoC (RUN-0009).
Fields marked verified_by=elaboration are computed from
asic/synthesis/memory_audit.ys. Fields marked verified_by=rtl are read from
the RTL source by scripts/eda/audit_memory.js. Fields marked
verified_by=manual are human decisions and are NOT proven by a tool.
The checker fails when the measured design and this file disagree, so drift
in either direction is caught. Do not edit a number here to make a check
pass: edit the design or record the decision explicitly.

decoded_totals.note: 16 KiB ROM + 32 KiB TCM + 128 KiB SRAM = 180224 B of addressable storage; the 18 B decode LUT is combinational, not addressable

implemented_totals.note: 16 KiB ROM + 32 KiB TCM + 128 KiB SRAM + 18 B LUT = 180242 B; plus 128 B register file and 8 B PLIC priority

memories.access_type: 2 read ports (instruction fetch, AXI4-Lite read), read-only
memories.reset_init: initial block fills all words with 32'h0000_0013 (NOP), then optional $readmemh from MEM_FILE (default empty)

memories.access_type: 2 read ports (AXI4-Lite read, instruction port), 1 write port with 4 byte-enable lanes
memories.reset_init: no array reset; contents undefined at power-up unless MEM_FILE is given (default empty)

memories.access_type: 2 read ports (AXI4-Lite read, instruction port), 1 write port with 4 byte-enable lanes
memories.reset_init: no array reset; contents undefined at power-up unless MEM_FILE is given (default empty)

memories.access_type: combinational lookup of the APB one-hot select (not addressable storage)
memories.synthesis_representation: $mem_v2 inferred from a case statement (proc_rom), RD_PORTS=1, WR_PORTS=0

reconciliation.detail: not addressable memory; listed so the 4th inferred memory is not unexplained

register_storage.access_type: 2 asynchronous read ports (rs1, rs2), 1 synchronous write port
register_storage.reset_init: every register cleared by the synchronous reset loop
register_storage.synthesis_representation: list of registers ($adff, one per 32-bit register)
register_storage.evidence: yosys log: 'Replacing memory \rf with list of registers. See rtl/rtl_top/riscv_core.sv:596'

register_storage.access_type: register read/write through the interrupt-controller aperture
register_storage.evidence: yosys log: 'Replacing memory \prio with list of registers. See rtl/rtl_peripherals/plic.sv:101'; NUM_SOURCES defaults to 8

absent_peripheral_memory.claim: the UART has no FIFO; FCR reads 0x01 and one byte is held
SPI, I2C, I2S and QSPI hold shift registers only; no arrays or FIFOs
absent_peripheral_memory.rtl_source: grep of rtl/rtl_peripherals for array declarations (only plic prio)
